errors.name: AlreadyReturnedLoanError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to return a loan that is already marked as returned.

errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book is not found during lookup by ID, title, author, or ISBN.

errors.name: AuthorNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an author is not found during lookup by ID or name.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a member is not found during lookup by ID or email.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a loan is not found during lookup by ID or member/book reference.

errors.name: InvalidBookCopiesError
errors.description: Raised when a book's available_copies is set to a negative value.

errors.name: InvalidLoanStatusError
errors.description: Raised when a loan status is set to an invalid value such as 'invalid' or 'unknown'.

errors.name: InvalidMemberIdError
errors.description: Raised when a member ID is not a valid integer or does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InvalidBookIdError
errors.description: Raised when a book ID is not a valid integer or does not exist in the system.

errors.name: MissingRequiredFieldError
errors.description: Raised when a required field (e.g., title, isbn, member_id, book_id) is missing in a command or request.
